About Us

Welcome to Kisshore Media Network Private Limited

Kisshore Media Network Private Limited is a trusted provider of networking and security solutions based in Hyderabad.

We specialize in designing, installing, and maintaining communication and surveillance systems for homes, apartments, offices, educational institutions, hospitals, and commercial establishments.

Our experienced team ensures every project is completed with precision, quality products, and excellent after-sales support.

FAQ

Frequently Asked Questions

Do you provide installation only?+

No. We provide installation as well as complete solutions, including the products themselves.

Do you provide AMC?+

Yes. Annual Maintenance Contracts are available for CCTV, networking and intercom systems.

Do you provide support after installation?+

Yes. We provide prompt after-sales support for every project we complete.

Do you work for apartments and offices?+

Yes. We serve residential, commercial, and industrial customers across Hyderabad.
